projects.title: CallDojo
projects.description: Voice role-play trainer for loan agents: talk to, and interrupt, an AI borrower in English, Hinglish or Tanglish, then get a scorecard. About 1.5 s to first audio; the scorer caught 7/7 misquoted rates and fees.

projects.title: ARIA Agent
projects.description: Autonomous Risk Intelligence Agent — fuses financial-filing anomaly scoring with live news risk into a 0–100 composite score. SSE live progress, PDF audit reports, under 30 s end-to-end.

projects.title: Explainable AI Research
projects.description: Research framework evaluating the stability and clinical reliability of post-hoc explainability methods like SHAP and LIME on healthcare predictive models.

projects.title: FinPilot
projects.description: PENTATHON 3.0 winner. Real-time transaction streaming, receipt parsing with line-item extraction and price-anomaly detection, PDF reports; sub-120 ms live UI updates.

projects.title: Trust Flow
projects.description: Customs compliance agent with an 11-node graph pipeline, human-in-the-loop review, bounding-box document provenance, US/UAE YAML rule engine, and live USITC HTS classification.

projects.title: Pluse
projects.description: Distributed job platform featuring atomic job claiming (SKIP LOCKED + advisory locks + lock-token fencing), DLQ with idempotent replay, and Groq-powered failure telemetry.

projects.title: PackAssist Demo
projects.description: Interactive showcase of 3D bin-packing and spatial layout engine for automotive trunk optimization. Features client-side greedy packing and live 3D orbital inspection.

projects.title: FlappyMind
projects.description: Deep RL agent trained with PPO on flappy-bird-gymnasium using a 180-ray LIDAR observation space. Deployed in-browser via Pygbag/Wasm with a high score of 451 pipes.

projects.title: Image Captioning
projects.description: Vision-language model pairing frozen ResNet50 with custom 6-layer Transformer decoder trained on MS COCO 2014 (118K images), achieving 24.5 BLEU-4 and 81.2 CIDEr.

projects.title: Translator App
projects.description: Text and image translation across 40+ languages using DeepL API, with Tesseract.js OCR for image-to-text input and browser text-to-speech output.

projects.title: Self-Pruning Neural Network
projects.description: Learnable sigmoid-gate pruning layer with an L1 gate penalty, trained on CIFAR-10; ~56% test accuracy across three sparsity penalties.

projects.title: translator.nlp
projects.description: English→Hindi neural machine translation: GRU Seq2Seq with Bahdanau attention, trained on ~118K IITB sentence pairs, with D3.js attention heatmaps.

projects.title: Scholarship & Financial Aid Portal
projects.description: DBMS course project (team of 2, project lead): admin and student roles, eligibility checks, document upload and finance reporting.

projects.title: BroLift
projects.description: College carpooling app: ride search, seat requests, fare split, live fuel-price scraping and ride chat. Built solo in 2-week sprints.

projects.title: PulseAPI
projects.description: Notification priority queue on a custom MinHeap and a knapsack-based vehicle maintenance scheduler, with a shared logging middleware package.
